CustomField.description: Loyalty programme tier, derived from the household's billed amount over the last 365 days (Last 12 Month Spend). Slabs: Silver 0-7,500 (2%), Gold 7,501-25,000 (4%), Platinum 25,001-100,000 (7%), Diamond 100,001 and above (10%). Because the source field is a rolling 12-month window, the tier moves up or down on its own as old transactions age out.
CustomField.label: Customer Tier
